title: Verfahren zur Aufhellung der Haut
abstract: Provided are methods of lightening skin by applying certain aromatic compounds or botanical extracts containing such compounds to the skin.
all_claims: The method of claim 1 or use of claim 2 wherein R 1  is selected from the group consisting of C 5  - C 16  alkyl, C 5  - C 16  alkenyl, and C 5  - C 16  alkynyl; R 2  is selected from the group consisting of hydrogen, hydroxyl, -OC 1  - C 6  alkyl, -OC 2  - C 6  alkenyl, - OC 2  - C 6  alkynyl, -OC 3  - C 8  cycloalkyl; R 3  is selected from -CO 2 H, -CO 2 R 4  wherein R 4  is C 1  - C 6  alkyl, or an isosteric equivalent of a carboxy group; and Y is -(CH 2 -CH 2 )- or - (CH=CH)-.
The method of claim 3 or use of claim 3 wherein R 1  is selected from the group consisting of C 5  - C 16  alkenyl; and R 2  is selected from the group consisting of hydrogen or -OC 1  - C 3  alkyl.

The method of claim 3 or use of claim 3 wherein the compound of Formula I is selected from the group consisting of 3-(4-farnesyloxyphenyl)-propionic acid, 3-(4-famesyloxy-3-hydroxyphenyl)-propionic acid, 3-(4-farnesyloxy-3-methoxyphenyl)-propionic acid, ethyl esters thereof, and combinations of two or more thereof.
The method of claim 4 or use of claim 4 wherein the compound of Formula I is 3-(4-farnesyloxyphenyl)-propionic acid.
The method or use according to any preceding claim comprising applying a to the skin a composition comprising from about 0.001 to about 10% of compound of Formula I.
The method or use of any preceding claim comprising applying to the skin a composition comprising from about 0.01 to about 1% of compound of Formula I.
The method or use of any preceding claim wherein said applying step comprises applying to the skin a composition comprising a botanical extract comprising a compound of Formula I.
The method or use of claim 9 wherein said botanical extract is an extract of a plant of the genus  Acronychia.
The method or use of claim 9 or claim 10 wherein said botanical extract is an extract  of Acronychia acidula.
The method or use of any one of claims 9 to 11 wherein said extract is a polar extract.
The method or use of any one of claims 7 to 12 wherein said composition further comprises at least one additional skin lightening active agent.
The method of any preceding claim wherein said skin in need of skin lightening is skin on a human face.

The method of claim 14 comprising applying to the skin on the human face a composition comprising a compound of Formula I, said composition being applied using a facial mask comprising a mask substrate and the composition comprising a compound of Formula I.
